يبتكروا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَكِرُوا (yabtakirū) /jab.ta.ki.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
# يُبْتَكَرُوا (yubtakarū) /jub.ta.ka.ruː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَكَرَ (ibtakara)
